name: ขนมจีนบุฟเฟ่ต์เฮือนจ๊างงามเชียงใหม่
context: If you’re in Chiang Mai, try ขนมจีนบุฟเฟ่ต์เฮือนจ๊างงามเชียงใหม่ (no English name, just copy that into Google Maps). It’s a local buffet with curries and noodles— annd only 99 baht.

name: Khao Soi Khun Yai
context: Khao Soi Khun Yai near Chang Phueak Gate was hands down the best I had.

name: Khao Soi Lung Prakit Kad Kom
context: Khao Soi Lung Prakit Kad Kom is amazing, too.

name: El Barrio Lanna
context: I stayed at El Barrio Lanna which is a boutique hotel in city center.

name: Sunday baker
context: Sunday baker - Cordon blue certified pastry chef

name: No.39 Cafe
context: No.39 Cafe - Super funky spot with a pond in the center (not swimmable) and a cute elevated stage for live music.

name: Transit Number 8
context: Transit Number 8 - The Japanese subway themed cafe not only has all the cute stops for photo ops both inside and outside.

name: Versaille de Flores
context: Versaille de Flores - boujie Parisian style architecture

name: Chom Cafe and Restaurant ชมคาเฟ่
context: Chom Cafe and Restaurant ชมคาเฟ่ - foggy forest makes you feel like a fairy.

name: Carp Cafe
context: Carp Cafe - has more than 1000 koi fish in the pond.

name: Ristr8to
context: My favorite cafe was Ristr8to. Absolutely top notch espresso.

name: Blue Temple
context: The blue, white, and black temples were stunning in person.

context: The black temples were stunning in person.

context: Doi Ithanan national park, i hired a local guide.
